none: PAS NLM-7B05F1: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine from Kirmington
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), issue of 355-361, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bust draped, cuirassed and diademed right. Obverse inscription: [--]TAN[--]. Reverse description: Soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman. Horseman equipped with bow and wearing vertically striped tunic. Reverse inscription: [FEL TEMP RE]PARATIO. Cliff Reeves kindly…
